author: Ankit
problem: Read an H by W grid of 'o' and '-' with exactly two 'o' squares (pieces). Print the minimum number of moves to bring one piece onto the other, where a move goes one square up, down, left or right.
bug_description: The column part uses o[1][0] (the second piece's row) instead of o[0][1] (the first piece's column).

comments.accurate: Prints the Manhattan distance between the two pieces: row gap plus column gap
comments.wrong_behavior: Counts the row gap between the pieces, then the second piece's offset from the diagonal
comments.wrong_location: Distance formula verified; check the grid scan when both pieces are in the same row
